cues.instruction: Soft ambient wash, slow attack, let the reverb bloom fully before the next cue
cues.camera: Wide establishing shot, slow push-in from a distant horizon line

cues.instruction: Add a low drone underneath the wash, keep the texture transparent
cues.camera: Hold the wide shot; foreground figures enter slowly from the left

cues.instruction: Introduce a simple repeating motif on a single instrument, loop it gently
cues.camera: Cut to a medium close-up of the protagonist at rest

cues.instruction: Layer the motif with a second voice in contrary motion, build the pattern slowly
cues.camera: Slow pan across the interior set, collecting ambient detail

cues.instruction: Let the motif decay naturally, allow silence to fill the gaps between phrases
cues.camera: Insert a brief cutaway to an object that will matter later

cues.instruction: Bring back the motif at a higher tempo with a driving eighth-note pulse
cues.camera: Match cut to action; the pace of editing tightens

cues.instruction: Add brass or synth pads beneath the pulse; let the harmony shift to the dominant
cues.camera: Steadicam tracking shot following the character through a crowd

cues.instruction: Resolve the rising tension with a short, clean statement of the home key
cues.camera: Close-up of a face registering decision or doubt

cues.instruction: Re-enter the drive with added distortion or saturation on the lead line
cues.camera: Over-the-shoulder cut to the antagonist entering the frame

cues.instruction: Strip the instrumentation back to a single pulsing note; let anticipation build
cues.camera: Slow zoom into a blank wall that the character will soon touch

cues.instruction: Hard cut to silence, then a low piano figure that resets the emotional center
cues.camera: Insert a neutral shot of the landscape stripped of people

cues.instruction: Sustained pad with slow filter sweep; the character exhales on screen
cues.camera: Static wide shot, allowing the silence to speak

cues.instruction: Re-enter with the original motif in a new key, played by an unfamiliar instrument
cues.camera: Close-up of hands performing, then cut to the listening character

cues.instruction: Build a counter-melody that harmonizes with the reset motif, layer gradually
cues.camera: Two-shot framing the character and the new presence side by side

cues.instruction: Anchor the counter-melody with a steady kick drum, lock the tempo to picture
cues.camera: Wide shot as the two figures begin to move in sync

cues.instruction: Double the tempo, stack thirds under the lead line, push toward the climax
cues.camera: Rapid cuts escalating through three reaction shots

cues.instruction: Add a rising scale figure and a snare roll; let the dissonance increase
cues.camera: Handheld shake on the moment of impact

cues.instruction: Crash to a single held chord with the full ensemble, then cut to a fermata
cues.camera: Extreme close-up of an eye reflecting the action

cues.instruction: Release the chord into a cascading arpeggio, brighter and faster than before
cues.camera: Pull back to reveal the full scale of the set

cues.instruction: Fade the arpeggio into a soft pedal tone; let the resolution feel earned
cues.camera: Slow dolly back as the character walks away from the climax

cues.instruction: Return to the opening wash texture, now transformed by the journey's events
cues.camera: Profile shot silhouetted against a warm key light

cues.instruction: Settle on a final sustained triad that does not fully resolve, leaving it open
cues.camera: Two-shot holding on the connection between the two figures

cues.instruction: Decay the triad into a low hum; let each note hang in the air before the next
cues.camera: Slow fade to black over ten seconds

cues.instruction: Add a distant chime or bell tone; keep the energy below the midpoint threshold
cues.camera: Title card or credit roll over the lingering ambient tone

cues.instruction: Final decay to near-silence, leaving only a breath of texture
cues.camera: Slow fade to black; hold for two seconds before cut
